text: To Steenbarger's hold: I stand behind h1_close_above:bar_high on H1 with no pull-in, ACT_NOW. The reaction (D red, 2.55% under) is turning: H1 HH/HL above EMA9 at 68.2%; waiting for a lower price misses the move (C5). Of the other clears, oneil's h1_close_above:pivot_high also clears me: clearing the pivotal point is my own trend-resumption rule (C17, C19); pct_from_pivot is not on my menu, so I cannot test his 5.09. reclaim:ma_20 buys the reaction and I object to it. Wrong if a one-day fall of 1x atr_14d from the day's high prints (C7, my translation).
